body:
## Bevy version

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/commit/c019a60b39c5683656025bc9d24a02744aa59dea

## What you did

Ran `cargo +nightly clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -Z unstable-options --keep-going -- -Aclippy::type_complexity -Wclippy::nursery -Aclippy::use_self -Aclippy::missing_const_for_fn -Aclippy::redundant_pub_crate -Aclippy::cognitive_complexity -Aclippy::branches_sharing_code -Aclippy::option_if_let_else -Aclippy::useless_let_if_seq -Aclippy::equatable_if_let -Aclippy::iter_with_drain -Aclippy::iter_on_single_items -Aclippy::iter_on_empty_collections -Aclippy::debug_assert_with_mut_call -Aclippy::as_ptr_cast_mut -Aclippy::type_repetition_in_bounds -Aclippy::trait_duplication_in_bounds -Aclippy::future_not_send -Aclippy::imprecise_flops -Aclippy::suboptimal_flops -Wclippy::doc_markdown -Wclippy::redundant_else -Wclippy::match_same_arms -Wclippy::semicolon_if_nothing_returned -Wclippy::explicit_iter_loop -Wclippy::map_flatten -Dwarnings`.

## What went wrong

```
error: consider implementing `TryFrom` instead
   --> crates\bevy_render\src\mesh\shape\icosphere.rs:23:1
    |
23  | / impl From<Icosphere> for Mesh {
24  | |     fn from(sphere: Icosphere) -> Self {
25  | |         if sphere.subdivisions >= 80 {
26  | |             /*
...   |
102 | |     }
103 | | }
    | |_^
    |
    = help: `From` is intended for infallible conversions only. Use `TryFrom` if there's a possibility for the conversion to fail
note: potential failure(s)
   --> crates\bevy_render\src\mesh\shape\icosphere.rs:57:13
    |
57  | / ...   panic!(
58  | | ...       "Cannot create an icosphere of {} subdivisions due to there being too many vertices being generated: {}. (Limited to 65535 vert...
59  | | ...       sphere.subdivisions,
60  | | ...       number_of_resulting_points
61  | | ...   );
    | |_______^
    = help: for further information visit https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/master/index.html#fallible_impl_from
    = note: `-D clippy::fallible-impl-from` implied by `-D warnings`
    = note: this error originates in the macro `$crate::panic::panic_2021` which comes from the expansion of the macro `panic` (in Nightly builds, run with -Z macro-backtrace for more info)
```
